items.title: School Uniforms
items.creator: Glorious Studios
items.description:
It is that time of year again, time to go back to school! Put on your best school uniforms and impress all your friends!

+ 21 skins

items.title: Modern Legends
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description: Modern teen skins will make anyone look great on their favorite server! These styles are up to date and will look great on your avatar!

items.title: Skins
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Skins are here!

Modern fashion trends for any season! Look cool today!

items.title: Playful Penguins
items.creator: Yeggs
items.description:
What’s black and white and amazing all over? That’s right. Penguins. Now you can have a taste of the fun with Playful Penguins.

+ Includes 9 boomstonishing skins!

items.title: Secret Warden Agents
items.creator: Hourglass Studios
items.description:
Down in the deep depths of the dark cave, there is a group of glowing agents hunting down the dangerous warden! Little do they know, they are the ones being hunted! Join these agent skins for your new adventure in the caves and cliffs update! Will you find the warden before he finds you?

- 8 warden themed agent skins!
- By: Hourglass Studios

items.title: Isekai Anime
items.creator: JFCrafters
items.description:
This Anime themed collection has decided to burst out of the comics and on to your screen. Catch them all and get ready to fight.
20 Awesome skins to use at your discretion. 
1 Free skin.

items.title: HIGH SCHOOL LIFE
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
These teens are ready for a great school year. Get ready for school in the latest fashion! Colorful, modern, and stylish. There is a skin for everyone!

+ Skin pack
+ Great for roleplay

items.title: Trendy Outfits
items.creator: DigiPort
items.description:
Do you like wearing trendy clothes? Then these outfits are perfect for you! Wear these and impress everyone with your coolness.

- 12 cool outfits
- 2 free skins!
- By rvan

items.title: Mob Glitch
items.creator: MobBlocks
items.description: See whats under your favourite mobs with these bright glitched skins.

items.title: Craftable Secret Bases
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description: Craftable Secret Bases brings 10 unique secret bases to craft and live in secret in your survival world!

items.title: Rainbow Noobs
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description: I love to noob it up rainbow style! Roleplay as hilarious yet cute and colorful noobs! It's fun to be derpy and adorable.

items.title: Obsidian Monsters
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description: These monsters are creepy and purple in color. They are made of obsidian after all! Roleplay as a horrifying obsidian monster and spook your friends! A glowing purple danger lurks in the shadows so watch out!

items.title: Grow Shroom
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description: These mushrooms love to grow on any surface! There are different color mushrooms in this skin pack. Perfect for hiding in plain sight, camouflaging with other shrooms or roleplaying as cute fungi.

items.title: Everyday Heroes HD
items.creator: BBB Studios
items.description: These heroes work day and night to make the world a better place! Now you can roleplay as fire firefighters, police officers, nurses, paramedics and teachers. Work together with your friends to fight fires, protect justice, teach valuable lessons and save lives! Thank you to all of the everyday heroes out there!

items.title: Undead Legion
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Risen from the grave a legion of fallen soldiers is wandering the scorched earth of the battlefield, seeking revenge against those who sent them on their journey to the afterlife!

- 12 skins
- By RareLoot

items.title: Mob Drip
items.creator: PixelOneUp
items.description: Yo MOB drip-themed clothing! Show off ya love for your favorite! From the infinite world, all the way to the end. Protect and defend your realm to become the most dripped-out character Minecraft has ever seen!

items.title: Mini World
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
Try the brand new Skyblock experience! Can you find all secret chests or will you fall off?

+ New Skyblock experience
+ Multiplayer friendly
+ Nether and End

items.title: Toys Retro
items.creator: ThunderAy
items.description:
Your life can be more fun in the retro mood! Play on any map choosing your favorite toy and enjoy the best vibes!

*Lots of fun ahead!
*12 exclusive and detailed skins!

items.title: Chill Teens 2021
items.creator: ThunderAy
items.description:
Being chill is not only a state of mind, it's also super cool!
Make sure to be chilling with these another-level teens.

+ 11 teen skins, providing you with the best vibes!
+ 1 FREE skin!
+ By Senior Studios & Lune!

items.title: Teen Legion
items.creator: Pixelationz Studios
items.description:
Love trendy clothing and stylish outfits? Then you'll enjoy this collection of fashionable teen attire. Whether playing solo or with friends, make a fashion statement wherever you go!
-1 Free

items.title: Ultimate Space Base
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
This is your chance to be the ultimate astronaut! Blast away from your planet and visit an asteroid field full of diamonds and other rare blocks! Expand your base among the stars, or take precious resources back to Earth with you using your super-fast space shuttle!

- Large asteroid belt to explore!
- Rocket shuttle with unlimited trips!
- Build on Earth or in space!

items.title: OP Neon
items.creator: KA Studios
items.description:
Check out these amazing OP Neon skins! Play with these trendy glowing outfits!

- Glowing outfits
- OP skins
- Trendy
- By KA Studios

items.title: Sunset Teens
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Dress up in warm colors, inspired by a mesmerizing sunset!

+ 12 brightly colored teen skins
+ A variety of stylish outfits

items.title: Melons
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
It's watermelon time! Dress up as a brave superhero melon, or as a builder, or even as a gummy melon!

+ 7 wild skins
+ Super random outfits
